name: hce-insumos-frontend
description: FrontEnd Next.js con enfoque de microfront (Multi-Zones) para la gestion de insumos medicos HCE

scripts.dev: concurrently -n shell,inventario -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @hce/shell" "npm run dev -w @hce/inventario"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @hce/api-cliente && npm run build -w @hce/ui && npm run build -w @hce/shell && npm run build -w @hce/inventario
